question: Which goddess is invoked with hrīṃ to protect on the right side?
premises: Protection is requested on the right side.
inference: Kālikā, invoked with hrīṃ hrīṃ, is asked to protect me on the right side.
uncertainties: The repetition of dakṣiṇe may be emphatic or formulaic.
plain_english: Hrīṃ, hrīṃ, may she protect me on the right; O Kālikā on the right, may you protect me.
